def: properly, to dangle, i.e. to let down abucket (for drawing out water); figuratively, to deliver

words.word: for thou hast lifted me up

occurrences.text: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.
And they said, An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and also drew water enough for us, and watered the flock.
I will extol thee, O Lord; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.
words: for thou hast lifted me up
